'''August 2001 Raleigh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Raleigh, NC on 18 August 2001. [[Mike Merletto]] won it. It is known from Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2860">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-raleigh-nc-8-18-01-absolute-moneyd2860/ raleigh-nc-8-18-01-absolute-money], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 19 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-raleigh-nc-8-18-01-absolute-moneyd2860/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 23
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Merletto]]
